record.question: What is a characteristic of a benign neoplasm?
options: It does not spread and usually has a more favorable prognosis
record.explanation: Answer D: It does not spread and usually has a more favorable prognosis. Benign neoplasms do not metastasize; the offered fourth statement is the defining contrast, though benign lesions can still cause harm by location or hormone production. Reference: https://training.seer.cancer.gov/disease/cancer/terms.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
